---
title: Agent Context
---

Select to capture semantic, visible-object, and Set-of-Mark context. Inspect
the captured structure in the browser console. When AI is available, the example
also asks Gemini to describe the scene.

Context capture and provider transmission are separate steps. Only the query
needs provider credentials. Use local keys for prototypes and
[server-controlled credentials](/integrations/ai-providers) for production.

[Scene context](/sdk/context) · [Agent quickstart](/get-started/agent-quickstart) · [Example catalog](/examples)
